retentionDays.paymentRecords: kept after erasure in reduced form (GDPR Art. 17(3)(b))

automatedDecisions.logic: fixed rules decide AUTO / ASK / HANDOFF / REFUSE for each proposed payment (caps, payee verification, sanctions screening, risk score); the AI cannot approve
automatedDecisions.safeguard: GDPR Art. 22(3): every refusal has reason codes; you can reject, change your rules, or contact us
